description: Grant readiness check for nonprofits. Default (engine v3): about 36 Yes / In progress / No questions across six sections (Governance, Tax and registrations, Financials, Organizational background, Program or project, Policies). Returns a readiness bar per section with "[x] ready, [y] in progress, [z] missing", up to four biggest gaps with a short expert answer, and a getting-started result when the organization has no bylaws and no Articles of Incorporation. Unanswered or "not_sure" items are reported as Not answered and excluded from the math (missing data is not the same as No). No overall score in v3. The legacy 91-field scan (0-100 score) remains available with engine_version "2".

inputSchema.description: Provide answers keyed by item id (G1, G1a, G2, G3, T1-T6, F1-F4, B1-B9, P1-P8, C1-C6) either flat or under "answers". Values: yes / in_progress / no / not_sure (drop-down items use their listed values). Omit anything unknown. Set engine_version "2" to use the legacy 91-field scan instead (flat field_id map or nested by readiness area).
